backend_to_ui.finding: Stage 00 intake exists but was not the dominant public product path.
backend_to_ui.resolution: Homepage now routes one plain-language bottleneck into /audit, then into the existing /intake/ context surface.

backend_to_ui.finding: Client Zero approval/evidence behavior belongs to the authenticated operator product, not the public acquisition homepage.
backend_to_ui.resolution: Public homepage explains human control; review actions remain under /app/client-zero.

backend_to_ui.finding: Detailed feature routes remain useful but are too technical as primary acquisition navigation.
backend_to_ui.resolution: Routes are preserved but removed from primary marketing navigation; capability is hidden by progressive disclosure rather than deleted.

ui_to_backend.finding: Old homepage offered three pricing/implementation choices before diagnosis.
ui_to_backend.resolution: Homepage now sells one front-door offer: the $497 Vibe Audit. Rescue Sprint, Sovereign Launch and MAXX Operations are explained as post-audit paths.

ui_to_backend.finding: Old proof panel described representative organization types rather than evidence-backed work.
ui_to_backend.resolution: Homepage now uses MACS Client Zero as the only current case study and includes an explicit runtime-proof caveat.

ui_to_backend.finding: Old homepage duplicated product explanation across many sections.
ui_to_backend.resolution: 15 homepage marketing sections reduced to seven bounded funnel sections.

ui_to_backend.finding: Legacy migration-audit form remains a separate route and capability.
ui_to_backend.resolution: It is preserved for compatibility, but new public CTAs route to the guided Vibe Audit entry instead of deleting the legacy flow.

release_constraints: Do not claim live Supabase tenant-isolation or approval receipts until runtime evidence exists.
Do not restyle the authenticated /app surface as part of this marketing redesign.
Do not remove preserved legacy capability routes in this slice.
Keep public interaction burden to one dominant next action and no more than three starter choices.
